_comment: Project-local board: a copy of platform-ststm32's nucleo_g491re with
libopencm3 added to `frameworks`.  The stock definition lists only
stm32cube, which is why `pio boards` does not offer this board for a
libopencm3 build -- but libopencm3 does support the part (its
ld/devices.data matches stm32g4?1?e* -> ROM=512K RAM=96K CCM=16K).
maximum_ram_size is deliberately 96K, not the chip's 112K: libopencm3's
generated linker script puts only SRAM1+SRAM2 in the `ram` region and
leaves the 16K CCM at 0x10000000, so 96K is what the link actually
enforces and what the RAM percentage should be measured against.
The frames fit in 96K with room to spare, so unlike the G431 build this
target needs no custom linker script.
Named with an _ocm3 suffix so the override is explicit: a same-named file
would silently shadow the platform's board if it ever gains libopencm3.
name: Nucleo G491RE (libopencm3)
